title: Public value recovery in AI, defense, data, and critical-infrastructure finance
governing_question: Can public capital, demand, data, infrastructure, accreditation, operational feedback, error, and risk be converted into enforceable residual rights that are actually realized and distributed in AI, defense, public-data, and critical-infrastructure finance?
transfer_rule: No cross-sector candidate reaches R7 without a bounded contribution → enforceable residual right → realized value → transparent public or affected-party distribution chain.

systems.residual_right: Senior preferred shares or debt, dividends, warrants, transfer and valuation rights, and bounded protective conditions.

systems.distribution: Recovery flowed to the federal public account; direct affected-household distribution is not established by CPP.
systems.open_join: Proportionality to total public risk and direct recovery for households and communities.

domain_adapter.name: Public Contribution and Residual Rights Covenant
minimum_rules: Every public and affected-party contribution must be separately named, valued where possible, and linked to the recipient and instrument.
Repayment, procurement value, tax receipts, employment, strategic capability, valuation, compensation, and residual upside remain separate ledgers.
R7 requires an enforceable right created before or contemporaneously with the contribution; ex post political claims to value do not suffice.
The right must be exercisable in the actual capital, contract, corporate, IP, data, or governance structure.
Valuation marks and unrealized gains cannot be counted as realized public value.
Realization must identify receipt, sale, dividend, royalty, revenue share, license income, recovered capacity, or another bounded value event.
Distribution must identify the public account, institution, community, worker, data subject, or affected population receiving the value.
Clawbacks and milestone withholding protect downside but do not automatically create residual upside.
Public investor or regulator governance does not substitute for affected-party R6 authority.
Failure, dilution, write-off, fee, tax, financing cost, opportunity cost, and successor arrangements remain in the denominator.
pilot_packet: recipient legal entity and beneficial owners
executed financing, procurement, data, IP, infrastructure, accreditation, or guarantee instrument
equity, preferred return, warrant, royalty, license, revenue-share, clawback, governance, and exit rights
valuation, milestone, failure, dilution, write-off, sale, and distribution chronology
fees, financing cost, tax, opportunity cost, and risk denominator
conflicts, intermediaries, fund managers, rights holders, and residual beneficiaries
successor, transfer, and long-run durability record
domain_adapter.burden_rule: The institution claiming R7 bears the burden to prove contribution, enforceable right, realization, and distribution; missing records cannot be replaced by valuation, capability, or generalized public-benefit claims.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Timely notice and direct voice regarding the public or affected-party contribution and proposed value-right structure.
r_level_tests.observation: Fund and award announcements are public, but complete terms and affected-party voice are not.
r_level_tests.domain_result: R1 is institutional rather than affected-party complete.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Inspection of executed terms, cap tables, valuation methods, performance, fees, distributions, and contribution ledgers.
r_level_tests.observation: Public summaries identify instrument classes while confidential agreements and portfolio accounts remain incomplete.
r_level_tests.domain_result: R2 is the main evidentiary bottleneck.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Independent power to withhold, pause, claw back, reprice, or block value transfer when conditions fail.
r_level_tests.observation: CHIPS uses milestones, compliance monitoring, and upside-sharing; public investors exercise investment governance, but observed enforcement denominators are open.
r_level_tests.domain_result: Downside and compliance controls are visible but not equivalent to realized upside.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Binding recovery, restitution, write-off recognition, compensation, or prohibition when the public or affected parties bear loss or injury.
r_level_tests.observation: TARP closes bounded public recovery; cross-sector compensation and affected-party remedy remain largely absent.
r_level_tests.domain_result: R4 cannot be imported from TARP into the candidate sectors.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Public operating capacity and durable institutional benefit rather than dependence on the private recipient.
r_level_tests.observation: NASA demonstrates public capability and CHIPS/NSSIF/NIF target strategic capacity, but capability does not itself establish residual-value recovery.
r_level_tests.domain_result: R5 and R7 are complementary but non-equivalent.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Affected-party representatives hold binding authority over contribution, risk, purpose, rights, valuation, exit, and distribution.
r_level_tests.observation: Government LPs, boards, investment teams, agencies, and fund managers govern instruments; affected populations are not shown as co-governors.
r_level_tests.domain_result: Public investor governance does not close R6.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Contribution becomes enforceable residual right, realized value, and transparent public or affected-party distribution.
r_level_tests.observation: TARP CPP is the bounded positive control. NIF, NSSIF, Polar, and I-Pulse establish right architectures without complete realization and distribution; NASA and NHS are negative or unresolved controls.
r_level_tests.domain_result: Cross-sector R7 transfer is not yet observed.

value_recovery_dimensions.requirement: Name and value public capital, demand, data, infrastructure, accreditation, labor, risk, error, or injury.
value_recovery_dimensions.failure_state: Public spending or exposure is described without a bounded contribution ledger.

value_recovery_dimensions.requirement: Create an enforceable equity, preferred, warrant, royalty, license, revenue-share, IP, governance, or contingent-upside right.
value_recovery_dimensions.failure_state: The public receives only generalized benefits, ordinary procurement value, or an unenforceable policy promise.

value_recovery_dimensions.requirement: Identify the trigger, decision authority, audit, valuation, and exercise of the right.
value_recovery_dimensions.failure_state: A paper right exists but cannot be tested, triggered, valued, or enforced.

value_recovery_dimensions.requirement: Record cash, securities, dividends, royalties, licenses, sale proceeds, recovered capacity, or another bounded value event.
value_recovery_dimensions.failure_state: Company valuation or strategic capability is counted as public receipt.

value_recovery_dimensions.requirement: Identify the public account and affected-party distribution rule and actual recipient.
value_recovery_dimensions.failure_state: Aggregate fiscal value is treated as direct recovery for affected people.

value_recovery_dimensions.requirement: Reconcile losses, write-offs, fees, financing cost, tax, opportunity cost, externalities, and public backstop.
value_recovery_dimensions.failure_state: Gross proceeds are reported without the risk and cost denominator.

value_recovery_dimensions.requirement: Separate public investor governance from affected-party co-governance and disclose conflicts and intermediaries.
value_recovery_dimensions.failure_state: LP status, board oversight, or agency discretion is called democratic or affected-party control.

value_recovery_dimensions.requirement: Preserve failed projects, withheld milestones, clawbacks, enforcement, dilution, and insolvency.
value_recovery_dimensions.failure_state: Only successful or highly valued recipients remain in the denominator.

value_recovery_dimensions.requirement: Govern transfer, sale, successor ownership, residual rights, and post-exit public capacity.
value_recovery_dimensions.failure_state: Rights disappear or become unusable through refinancing, sale, dilution, or successor structures.

value_recovery_dimensions.requirement: Rebuild the instrument for each sector's legal, technical, valuation, security, and distribution conditions.
value_recovery_dimensions.failure_state: A banking, venture, grant, or procurement mechanism is transplanted by analogy.

fault_lines.name: spending versus contribution
fault_lines.observation: An appropriation or contract price does not identify the full public contribution or risk.

fault_lines.name: repayment versus residual upside
fault_lines.observation: Return of principal is not a share of newly created or preserved value.
fault_lines.required_control: Separate principal, preferred return, contingent upside, and residual-right ledgers.

fault_lines.name: valuation versus realization
fault_lines.observation: A higher financing-round valuation does not show sale, dividend, distribution, or spendable public value.

fault_lines.name: public fiscal recovery versus affected-party recovery
fault_lines.observation: Treasury or fund proceeds do not automatically compensate workers, data subjects, communities, or other risk bearers.
fault_lines.required_control: Named distribution rule and recipient ledger.

fault_lines.name: capability versus value recovery
fault_lines.observation: Strategic capacity, procurement savings, jobs, and adoption may be valuable without creating an R7 residual right.
fault_lines.required_control: Keep institutional capability and financial or distributive value separate.

fault_lines.name: clawback versus upside
fault_lines.observation: Milestone withholding and clawbacks protect downside but may not share upside.
fault_lines.required_control: Identify both downside protection and residual participation.

fault_lines.name: paper equity versus exercisable value
fault_lines.observation: An equity stake may be diluted, illiquid, nontransferable, nonvoting, or worthless.
fault_lines.required_control: Cap table, rights, valuation, dilution, exit, and distribution.

fault_lines.name: public LP versus affected-party governance
fault_lines.observation: Government limited partners and professional fund managers do not represent every public or affected population.
fault_lines.required_control: Separate investor governance, democratic accountability, and R6 affected-party authority.

fault_lines.name: market creation versus ownership
fault_lines.observation: Public demand and technical collaboration can create a market while private firms retain the residual financial upside.
fault_lines.required_control: Executed residual-right or explicit negative-control record.

fault_lines.name: public data versus public residual right
fault_lines.observation: Public data and operational learning may improve private products without an explicit royalty, equity, IP, or value-distribution instrument.
fault_lines.required_control: Data, derivative, model-learning, IP, revenue, and distribution terms.

fault_lines.name: success story versus denominator
fault_lines.observation: Unicorn valuations and successful awards can hide failures, losses, write-offs, and forgone alternatives.

fault_lines.name: one instrument versus transferability
fault_lines.observation: TARP warrants, venture equity, CHIPS upside sharing, and procurement contracts operate under different legal and valuation constitutions.

cross_system_controls.claim: TARP CPP provides an observed bounded R7 control.
cross_system_controls.limit: The control is bank-capital-specific and does not transfer automatically.

cross_system_controls.claim: NIF and NSSIF establish public equity and fund-right architectures.
cross_system_controls.limit: Realized proceeds, losses, fees, and distribution remain open.

cross_system_controls.claim: CHIPS Polar and I-Pulse establish contingent-upside and direct-equity instruments.
cross_system_controls.limit: Trigger, realization, valuation, and distribution remain unobserved.

cross_system_controls.claim: ICEYE's reported valuation proves realized public return to NSSIF.
cross_system_controls.limit: Valuation is not sale, dividend, distribution, or complete portfolio accounting.

cross_system_controls.claim: NASA COTS capability and market creation prove a public residual financial right.
cross_system_controls.limit: The frozen record identifies milestone payments and procurement, not equity, warrants, royalties, or revenue sharing.

cross_system_controls.claim: Public data, demand, and operational learning in NHS platforms prove affected-party R7.
cross_system_controls.limit: No patient or public contribution-to-right-to-realization-to-distribution instrument is closed.

cross_system_controls.claim: Public investor governance proves R6 affected-party co-governance.
cross_system_controls.limit: Government, board, agency, or fund-manager authority is not the same as binding authority held by represented people.

cross_system_controls.claim: The frozen candidate set proves cross-sector R7 transfer.
cross_system_controls.limit: Only TARP closes realization; other sectors close rights design or public capability at lower ceilings.

propositions.claim: TARP CPP remains the observed bounded R7 positive control.
propositions.support: Public capital was joined to preferred returns, warrants, realized transaction proceeds, program losses, financing expense, and final net-income accounting.
counterevidence: TARP as a whole had a net subsidy cost
affected households did not receive CPP-specific proportional distributions
financial recovery does not close full social cost
propositions.falsifier: Official final records reverse the CPP net-income or transaction-realization findings.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep the positive control bounded to the exact CPP financial constitution.

propositions.claim: The NATO Innovation Fund establishes a multi-sovereign public Limited Partner and venture-equity architecture.
propositions.support: Participating Allied governments are Limited Partners in a EUR 1 billion fund making direct and indirect venture investments.
counterevidence: professional managers and board hold operational investment authority
complete partnership economics are not public
national distribution is unresolved
propositions.falsifier: The Allies possess no enforceable economic interest in portfolio outcomes.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not assign realized R7 without distributions and accounting.

propositions.claim: The NATO Innovation Fund has already produced transparent realized public returns distributed to participating Allies.
propositions.support: The fund is operational and invests for commercial success.
counterevidence: no complete distributions, fees, losses, or national accounting in the frozen record
propositions.falsifier: Audited records show no distributions or only losses after fees and costs.
propositions.stopping_rule: Close only with audited cost, valuation, exit, receipt, and distribution records.

propositions.claim: NSSIF establishes direct public equity and aligned-fund investment in dual-use, AI, data, and defense technology.
propositions.support: NSSIF states that it makes direct equity investments and aligned-fund investments and has announced strategic investments in data and national-security companies.
counterevidence: investment amounts and terms are often absent
work programmes and equity must remain separate
portfolio accounts are incomplete
propositions.falsifier: Operative records show the public held no equity or fund interest.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep each portfolio company and fund as a separate instrument.

propositions.claim: ICEYE's EUR 2.4 billion valuation proves NSSIF realized and distributed a public return.
propositions.support: The valuation is a material portfolio indicator.
counterevidence: no sale, dividend, distribution, cost basis, ownership percentage, or portfolio accounting is shown
propositions.falsifier: A sale or distribution record links the valuation event to realized NSSIF proceeds.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not count financing-round valuation as public receipt.

propositions.claim: The Polar CHIPS award includes an enforceable contingent upside-sharing right.
propositions.support: The official award summary states that Polar committed to an upside-sharing agreement despite being below the ordinary threshold.
counterevidence: the formula and trigger are not public
no payment or realization is observed
propositions.falsifier: The final agreement contains no enforceable upside-sharing obligation.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep right design separate from realization.

propositions.claim: The I-Pulse CHIPS agreement gives the Department a direct minority equity right.
propositions.support: The Department announced a definitive agreement and receipt of a minority non-controlling equity stake.
counterevidence: ownership percentage and terms are absent
no valuation, dividend, sale, or distribution is observed
propositions.falsifier: The equity statement was nonbinding, revoked, or provided no enforceable economic interest.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not assign R7 realization from equity existence alone.

counterevidence: no trigger, payment, valuation, exit, receipt, or distribution is observed
propositions.falsifier: Audited award records show no realized public value or unusable rights.
propositions.stopping_rule: Close only after an observed receipt and distribution ledger.

propositions.claim: NASA COTS produced public capability and commercial market formation.
propositions.support: NASA supplied milestone capital and technical support, and the program transitioned to commercial cargo procurement.
counterevidence: the complete counterfactual and private value attribution are open
capability is not a financial residual right
propositions.falsifier: The program produced no operational capability or commercial service.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep capability and R7 financial recovery separate.

propositions.claim: NASA COTS gives the public a closed equity, warrant, royalty, or revenue-sharing right in recipient-company upside.
propositions.support: NASA received services, demonstrations, capability, and later procurement competition.
counterevidence: no residual financial instrument is identified in the frozen record
propositions.falsifier: Executed agreements identify an enforceable public residual financial right and its realization.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not infer equity from the word investment.

propositions.claim: Public health data, demand, workflows, and operational risk may contribute to private data-platform value.
propositions.support: The public institution supplies data, procurement demand, operating context, and transition and governance surfaces.
counterevidence: public service value and vendor value are not causally reconciled
formal public data rights exist
vendor profit and learning terms are incomplete
propositions.falsifier: Complete records show no material vendor learning, valuation, IP, or economic benefit attributable to public data or deployment.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not infer private value from contract size or platform presence.

propositions.claim: The current NHS data-platform record establishes an affected-person R7 distribution right.
propositions.support: Formal public data and governance protections can preserve public interests.
counterevidence: no patient royalty, equity, profit share, dividend, or institutional-capacity distribution instrument is closed
propositions.falsifier: Executed terms provide enforceable patient or public residual rights and observed distribution.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep privacy, data ownership, public capacity, R6, and R7 separate.

propositions.claim: Public-account recovery is equivalent to direct affected-party recovery.
propositions.support: General public recovery may strengthen public finances or capacity.
counterevidence: affected people may bear distinct data, labor, community, error, or injury contributions
no proportional distribution follows automatically
propositions.falsifier: A binding distribution rule joins the affected population to realized value.
propositions.stopping_rule: Name the recipient class and distribution rule.

propositions.claim: Government LP, agency, board, or fund-manager authority proves R6 affected-party co-governance.
propositions.support: Public institutions can impose strategy, monitoring, milestones, and conditions.
counterevidence: represented workers, communities, data subjects, and users are not shown with binding authority
propositions.falsifier: The operative instrument gives accountable affected-party representatives binding authority over purpose, terms, exit, and distribution.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep public principal authority and R6 separate.

propositions.claim: APC-VALUE-01 is an observed cross-sector R7 answer.
propositions.support: The candidate set identifies public LP equity, direct equity, contingent upside, capability-without-rights, and data-contribution controls.
counterevidence: only the TARP control closes realization
no candidate sector closes affected-party distribution
terms and portfolio denominators remain incomplete
propositions.falsifier: Prospective pilots show the covenant cannot be executed, valued, enforced, realized, or distributed without defeating the public mission.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep the adapter at candidate design until one non-bank sector closes the full chain.

current_result.strongest_result: NIF, NSSIF, and CHIPS show that public equity and upside-sharing instruments are legally and institutionally available in dual-use and critical-technology finance.
current_result.strongest_fault_line: Equity, upside-sharing, valuation, capability, and public-account recovery remain distinct from realized and affected-party-distributed R7 value.
current_result.largest_open_join: Executed terms, portfolio denominators, realized receipts, public accounting, affected-party distribution, and durability through dilution, exit, and successor arrangements.
